more bug fixes + follow mode and a system theme:

- follow mode now follows the person you pick, instead of only drawing a border (#328, #340)
- the theme follows from your system light/dark setting (if you never picked a theme, it now follows your system) (#301)
- a stale editor tab no longer wipes your personal library (#313)
- api keys now work for live collaboration, and revoked keys are cut off on open connections (#316, #315)
- renaming a drawing or collection now saves when you click away, and escape cancels (#341)
- the app now works behind reverse proxies that keep the `/api` prefix (#323)
- bump archiver, glob and follow-redirects (#342, #343)

thank you to everyone who contributed!

- code: @alexbrasetvik (#328), @eudu (#316), @Mikhaylov-yv (#301)
- reports: @plukyanov (#313), @MathiasLui (#340, #341), @eudu (#315), @rjrisen (#323)
